datasetId.title: Dataset ID
datasetId.description: ID of the Apify dataset to export (from the Storage tab or a previous run). Use this OR Source URL.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: Public URL of a CSV, JSON array, or JSON Lines file. Use this OR Dataset ID.

spreadsheetId.title: Google spreadsheet ID
spreadsheetId.description: Optional. The long ID in the sheet URL between /d/ and /edit. Share the spreadsheet with your service account email as an Editor first. Leave empty to only produce CSV/XLSX files.

serviceAccountKey.title: Service account key (JSON)
serviceAccountKey.description: Required for Google Sheets. Paste your own service-account JSON key. It is encrypted by Apify, used only for this run, and never logged.

sheetName.title: Tab name
sheetName.description: Worksheet tab to write to. Created if missing.

outputFormats.title: File outputs
outputFormats.description: Files saved to the run's key-value store (OUTPUT.csv / OUTPUT.xlsx).

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many source rows.

maxColumns.title: Max columns
maxColumns.description: Nested fields are flattened to dot.path columns; extra columns beyond this are dropped (and listed in the log).
